questions.q: Which data type is most suitable for storing a telephone number such as 0034 612 345 678?
questions.why: You do not calculate with it and leading zeros/spaces must be kept, so use a string.

questions.q: What is the value of 17 MOD 5?
Which loop always runs its body at least once?
questions.why: REPEAT … UNTIL tests its condition at the end of each pass.

questions.q: Give two reasons for using a constant such as VAT_RATE instead of typing 0.2 each time.
questions.model: The value only has to be changed in one place if it changes, and the code is easier to read because the name explains what the number means.
